subject: Pricing packet delivered — quick run-through?
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@nimblefinance.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing packet for Nimble Finance — estimate and options

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. I appreciated the clarity on the two production paths you described (batch scoring vs. nearline inference). Per our conversation I attached a compact pricing packet with 2 commercial options and a usage-based estimate based on the sample throughput you shared.

What you'll find attached: 
- Nimble_Finance_Pricing_Proposal_v2.pdf — a short (3-page) commercial summary + SLAs and billing cadence
- nimble_usage_estimate.csv — token/throughput assumptions and cost sensitivity by qps

High-level ask: please confirm you received the packet and whether you'd prefer a short run-through with engineering included (I can do 15 minutes to walk the commercial items and show the deployment variants) or a 30–45 minute session to include a deep-dive on autoscaling and KV caching behavior.

Suggested next steps:
- Reply with a preference (15m commercial run-through or 45m technical + commercial)
- If 15m, I can offer these slots: Mon 11/8 9:15am PT, Tue 11/9 10:00am PT, Tue 11/9 3:30pm PT

Attachment: Nimble_Finance_Pricing_Proposal_v2.pdf (PDF, 86KB)
Attachment: nimble_usage_estimate.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Thanks — happy to tweak numbers if you want me to run a slightly different throughput profile.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0167

Thanks,
